description: The plot illustrates the results of DPR with different expansion methods on the dev set of MS-Marco. The x-axis represents the expansion methods, labeled as "corpus expansion", "document expansion", and "asymmetric expansion", with a categorical scale. The y-axis represents the performance metric, but its label is not visible; however, it has a numeric scale ranging from an unspecified lower limit to an unspecified upper limit. There are three data points connected by lines, representing the performance of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion, with the line for corpus expansion starting at a certain value and remaining steady, the line for document expansion starting at a lower value and increasing, and the line for asymmetric expansion starting at a similar value to document expansion and also increasing, but with a more gradual slope, with exact values not discernible from the text description alone.
